name: Daoist Immortal Han Xiangzi
material: porcelain with famille verte overglaze enamel decoration
summary: One of the Eight Immortals, Han Xiangzi was said to be the nephew of the famous Tang dynasty poet Han Yu (768–824). He is usually shown as a young boy holding a flute.
